speaker: Reed
text: Structure analysis and structured writing. 1 Analyze the structure of Text A as a causal analysis essay (opening, thesis question, three causes, conclusion), then read the sample essay on why people learn Chinese and see how the causes are developed. 2 Write an essay of no less than 140 words on "Why reading books is important?" following the outline: thesis statement, Cause 1 (broaden knowledge and provide experience), Cause 2 (exercise our brains and improve mental health), Cause 3 (increase empathy and make communication more efficient), and a conclusion.
